items.title: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?
items.summary: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.
items.author: Katie Drummond

items.title: Nvidia Was Already in Trouble Before the Jensen Huang Mess
items.summary: AI competitors are catching up to Nvidia—and poised to take advantage of the chaos.
items.author: Will Knight
